title: Smoked Chicken Tikka Skillet with Asparagus
description: A delicious Indian-inspired dish made with smoked chicken, asparagus, and a blend of spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of Skillet Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Smoked Chicken Breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of Skillet Oil to the skillet. Add the Asparagus and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Garam Masala, Cumin Powder, Salt, and Black Pepper to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked Smoked Chicken Breast back to the skillet and stir to combine.
If using Heavy Cream, stir it in at this point.
Serve the Smoked Chicken Tikka Skillet with Asparagus hot, garnished with Fantastic Fresh Cilantro.
Serve with Basmati rice or naan bread, if desired.
